dedupe_keys.name: tilapia ras dataset underwater videos and polygon annotated frames with physicochemical metadata

description: Tecnológico Nacional de México researchers publish underwater imagery from a commercial recirculating tilapia aquaculture system integrated with hydroponics in Querétaro. Thirty-one curated thirty-second clips span varying turbidity, lighting, camera depth and resolution. The 2025 Zenodo release includes 3,520 annotated frames from four clips, polygon masks in LabelMe JSON, and synchronized CSV water-quality metadata. CC BY 4.0 permits free reuse. These site-specific observations can train visual monitoring components and calibrate behaviour-related aquaculture simulations. The selected clips and limited annotation subset do not represent all farm conditions or continuous production histories. No model execution or video payload inspection was performed. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
name: Tilapia-RAS Dataset: Underwater Videos and Polygon-Annotated Frames with Physicochemical Metadata
notes: G4-0387; G4 other data journals. Metadata only. Simulation uses are reviewer assessments. Data payloads and code execution were not checked.
